title: Arthur742Ramos/jacobian-conjecture-lean
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
summary: An independent Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of the explicit three-dimensional polynomial map announced by Levent Alpöge in 2026. The project proves that its formal Jacobian determinant is the nonzero constant -2, verifies an explicit three-point fibre over the complex numbers, and derives the failure of injectivity required to refute the dimension-three Jacobian conjecture. The source formulas and proof scope are recorded explicitly; no claim is made about the still-open two-dimensional case.

formalizes.title: An explicit counterexample to the Jacobian conjecture

review.reason: Lean formalization refuting injectivity for an explicit three-dimensional polynomial map with unit Jacobian.
